name: Stranded Hearts
source:
Stranded Hearts is a lesbian romance/survival sim. Three completely different women become stranded on an uninhabited island. As Aina Monteil's past unravels amidst the harsh survival situation, will she be able to form a genuine connection for the first time in her life?

[From [url=https://dreamgate.itch.io/stranded-hearts]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《搁浅之心》是一款女同性恋浪漫/生存模拟游戏。三个截然不同的女人被困在一个无人岛上。艾娜·蒙泰尔 (Aina Monteil) 的过去在严峻的生存形势下被揭开，她能否在人生中第一次建立真正的联系？

[来自[url=https://dreamgate.itch.io/stranded-hearts]Itch.io[/url]]
